name: Surge by Peak XV
stage: Idea-stage: yes (application form accepts 'Idea/Prototype', 'Pre-launch/Beta', 'Launched'; FAQ says they invest at idea stage, pre-launch). Whether an unincorporated team can apply is unknown.
check_size_terms: $500K to $5M seed capital, equity; no board seat; open architecture that welcomes co-investors (official FAQ). Exact equity percentage not published.
sectors: Sector-agnostic technology (AI, SaaS, consumer, fintech, deep tech)
geography: India and Southeast Asia focus; global founders accepted; offices in India, Singapore, US, UAE
application_timing: rolling (applications open year-round); next cohort starts September 2026 per official FAQ (checked 2026-09-02); team replies within 2-3 weeks
best_channel: application form; cold outreach accepted (FAQ invites founders to find a Surge team member on LinkedIn and message them)
notes: 16-week program with in-person kick-off and close, weekly online sessions, and a San Francisco immersion. Selection weighs founder strength, market size, and, for launched companies, early customer love. Only ~2-3 week review time; no warm intro required.

name: Accel Atoms
stage: Idea-stage: yes (official FAQ: pre-product or pre-revenue companies are most relevant; ideas accepted early irrespective of an MVP; incorporation is not required to apply but is required before investment).
check_size_terms: Up to $1M for startups that make exceptional progress; Atoms AI and Atoms X tracks invest up to $1M-$2M, as equity or a convertible note (official FAQ). Standard valuation or discount terms not published.
sectors: AI, Bharat, Industry 5.0, SaaS, consumer, fintech, healthtech
geography: Founders based in India and Indian-origin founders anywhere in the world
application_timing: rolling per official FAQ, with cohort intakes; Atoms AI Cohort 2026 applications closed 26 January 2026 and the cohort began February 2026; next cohort date unknown
best_channel: application form; site directs founders to the form and to follow LinkedIn/X for cohort updates; no contact email published
notes: Pre-seed scaling program by Accel India; 2026 AI cohort partnered with Google's AI Futures Fund (early DeepMind model access, $5M+ perks). They look for exceptional teams with clarity on customer and market, conviction on the ICP need-state, and large category opportunities.

name: Blume Ventures
stage: Idea-stage: no open pre-seed or idea-stage program found on the official site. Blume is a seed / pre-Series A fund; a secondary profile says they generally do not invest at idea or pre-MVP stage with first-time founders, with exceptions for repeat founders and seasoned operators.
check_size_terms: unknown on official site; secondary source (superscout) reports $200K to $2.5M seed and Series A cheques
sectors: Sector-agnostic India: consumer, fintech, SaaS, healthcare, deep tech, climate, edtech
geography: India (offices in Mumbai, Bangalore, New Delhi)
application_url: unknown (official contact page states there is no pitch form and no common pitch email; founders must find the relevant investment team member via the team page and their social profiles)
application_timing: rolling (no program; direct pitches to the investment team only)
best_channel: warm intro or cold email / LinkedIn or X DM to the sector-relevant investment team member; official page says cold write-ins are allowed after reading the FAQs, but other emails on the contact page will not forward pitches
notes: Not an idea-stage program. Blume asks founders to read the FAQs on the home page before pitching and to target the investment partner covering their sector. Media and IR mailboxes explicitly do not accept pitches.

name: 100X.VC
stage: Idea-stage: partly. Official iSAFE page says the instrument works when a startup is 'at the idea, MVP, or very early revenue stage'; the Class 10 announcement targeted founders raising their first cheque; a secondary listing shows product stage only. Company incorporation in India is needed to sign an iSAFE.
check_size_terms: INR 1.25 Cr for 15% of future equity via iSAFE note (per the Class 10 announcement on LinkedIn; the current official site publishes no amount)
sectors: Sector-agnostic (deeptech, enterprise tech, SaaS, healthtech, fintech, D2C, web3)
application_url: unknown (as of 2026-09-02 the official site has no application form; the former Class 10 form at www.100x.vc/class10 returns 404)
application_timing: unknown (historically rolling applications with cohort 'Classes' and a 7-10 working day response; no open class is shown on the official site as of 2026-09-02)
best_channel: application form when a Class is open; otherwise LinkedIn; cold outreach acceptance unknown
notes: Pioneered the iSAFE (India SAFE) in 2019; 180+ companies funded. Program included a 6-week HomeRun MasterClass in Mumbai and a VC Pitch Day for follow-on rounds. Verify the current Class status before outreach because the site was recently rebuilt and lists no class.

name: Seedcamp
stage: Idea-stage: yes (official FAQ: 'From the moment you have an idea through to early revenue, we'd love to hear from you'; pre-product and pre-revenue accepted; the founder and ambition matter more than the stage).
check_size_terms: First cheque usually $350K to $1.25M; convertible (Seedcamp ASA) or equity on Seedsummit standard terms; equity percentage not published
sectors: Sector-agnostic software and technology (AI, fintech, healthtech, deep tech, infrastructure)
geography: Europe and Israel, or companies with a distinctively European angle; based in London
application_timing: rolling (no deadlines; process starts with a call, then a 45-minute partner pitch)
best_channel: application form ('Pitch Us'); cold applications accepted
notes: Europe's seed fund with Revolut, Wise, UiPath, Synthesia in the portfolio. They take small first positions, build a syndicate around the founder, and follow on aggressively. Not a fit if you have already raised more than a couple of million dollars.

name: STATION F Founders Program
stage: Idea-stage: unclear to no. Current page lists the audience as 'Tech startups (early stage)'; the 2020 call for applications required a full-time team and an MVP. Treat as post-idea (MVP expected).
check_size_terms: No investment by default; desk fee from EUR 259 per desk per month; page mentions 'a chance to receive funding from STATION F' with no amount published
geography: Paris, France (on-campus, hybrid with minimum presence required); languages French and English
application_timing: rolling (applications reviewed on a rolling basis; duration 3 to 18 months). Note: the separate F/ai Program is closed with next batch 15 September 2026; the free Fighters Program deadline is 18 October 2026.
notes: Most selective in-house program on the STATION F campus; gives mentorship from experienced founders, fast-track access to VCs, and proximity to the STATION F team. It is a paid incubator seat, not a cheque. Fighters Program is a free alternative for founders from underprivileged backgrounds.

name: Iterative
stage: Idea-stage: yes (official apply page: they have invested in companies that were 2-week-old concepts without any traction; no traction is required).
check_size_terms: $150K to $500K for roughly 10-15% of the company; full amount invested up front; no milestones, no clawbacks, no program fees
geography: Southeast Asia focus; founders from anywhere; investor network in Southeast Asia and San Francisco
application_timing: batch (two batches per year, 3-month cohort plus Demo Day); Winter 2027 batch (February to May 2027) is accepting applications as of 2026-09-02; the exact deadline date is not published
best_channel: application form; email hello@iterative.vc for questions
notes: YC-style accelerator for Southeast Asia founded by Hsu Ken Ooi and Brian Ma (ex-Decide.com, Divvy). Selection looks at Market, Evidence, and Founder. Applications are reviewed quickly and the program stresses that traction is not required.

name: Lightspeed Extreme Entrepreneurs
stage: Idea-stage: historically any stage (2018 launch coverage: no stage requirement, founders 'hungry to learn'). Status: appears inactive; no 2025-2026 cohort evidence found.
check_size_terms: No investment; an 8-week training and mentoring series with no equity or debt deal (per 2018 launch coverage)
geography: India and Southeast Asia (sessions historically in Lightspeed's Bengaluru office)
website: unknown (ee.lsvp.com returns 404 as of 2026-09-02; no program page on lsvp.com)
application_timing: paused / inactive: the last documented cohort is Extreme Entrepreneurs 3.0 (launched November 2020); the application site ee.lsvp.com returns 404 as of 2026-09-02. Lightspeed's current India early-stage program is India Ascends 2026 (under-25 deep-tech founders; applications closed 12 January 2026).
best_channel: unknown (program inactive); watch for India Ascends 2027 or approach Lightspeed India partners via warm intro
notes: Acceptance rate was about 1.4% with eight startups per cohort. Lightspeed appears to have replaced this with India Ascends (under-25 R&D-first founders; 3-4 winners receive $200K to $3M plus ~$500K in credits). Do not rely on this program for 2026.

name: Antler India
stage: Idea-stage: yes (pre-launch, pre-product, pre-revenue teams; apply form lists 'Idea to Pre-Seed'). A full-time team is expected for the residency; solo founders who need a co-founder are pointed to the invite-only 'Before Day Zero' community.
check_size_terms: INR 4 Cr (~$470K) for 11% total; one-time INR 2L grant for expenses; free office space; $1M+ in AI perks; potential up to $30M follow-on capital
sectors: AI-first startups (Antler India AI Residency); sector-agnostic otherwise
geography: Bengaluru (Bangalore), India; in-person for the first 2 weeks of the residency
application_timing: batch (residency); next residency 'will be announced soon' as of 2026-09-02; the site says to reach out directly at any time in the meantime
best_channel: application form; site invites direct contact at any time (Antler Direct for teams that do not need a program)
notes: 3-week decision cycle: 2 weeks of programming and 1-1 sessions, then a funding decision. India partners are Rajiv Srivatsa and Nitin Sharma. Looks for full-time teams already experimenting with users to sharpen MVP clarity.

name: Titan Capital
stage: Idea-stage: reported yes by a secondary listing (idea, product, and revenue stages eligible); the official site says 'operator-led early stage capital' and states no stage floor. Official confirmation of idea-stage acceptance not found.
check_size_terms: unknown on official site; secondary sources report $300K to $500K initial cheques at pre-seed and seed
sectors: Consumer internet, D2C brands, SaaS, fintech; 2026 'Future Indicorns' push on AI for India
application_url: unknown (no form; official contact page says to email startups@titancapital.vc to raise funds)
application_timing: rolling by email; a Titan Capital early-stage round listed on StartupGrantsIndia closed 20 February 2026; the Future Indicorns AI program deadline was reported as 15 June 2026 (closed)
best_channel: cold email (startups@titancapital.vc is published for fundraising pitches)
notes: Founded by Snapdeal founders Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal; 200+ portfolio companies including Ola, Razorpay, Urban Company. Runs a monthly 'Campus Chai' event for student entrepreneurs (Google Form on the contact page). Added as an extra open-application India pre-seed investor.
